test_PackTag: test the wire_format PackTag function to pack a field number and wire type into a protobuf tag
test_UnpackTag: test the wire_format UnpackTag function to unpack a protobuf tag into its field number and wire type
test_ZigZagEncode: test the wire_format ZigZagEncode function to encode signed integers into unsigned varints for efficient protobuf encoding
test_ZigZagDecode: test the wire_format ZigZagDecode function to decode zigzag-encoded unsigned varints back into signed integers
test_ByteSizeFunctions: test the wire_format ByteSize functions to calculate serialized byte sizes for int32, int64, string, and message fields
